sections.title: What is chain link mesh (diamond fencing net / jali)?
sections.body:
What is chain link mesh (diamond fencing net / jali)?

  Chain link mesh is interlocked diamond wire fence fabric supplied in rolls - also searched as chainlink fencing, chain-link fence, diamond mesh, diamond wire mesh, fencing mesh, fencing net, fencing jali, diamond jali, heera jali, or chain link jali. At GARG INDUSTRIAL MESH (Noida Sector 9) we supply it in GI (galvanized / galvanised) and MS (mild steel) with a published size matrix so BOQs and RFQs match what leaves the works.

  Buyers paste stacks like 6ft - 50 mm - 3 mm wire - GI - 50 ft roll. That language is how we quote - height in feet, wire and box in millimetres, roll length confirmed. We manufacture this fabric in India for fabric-first RFQs - factory-direct from Delhi NCR, not a vague "premium fencing solutions" brochure.


    Not the same as other "jali"
    Chain link = diamond fence fabric in rolls. It is not woven square wire mesh, welded mesh panels, expanded metal, mosquito net, or perforated / punching sheet (solid plate with punched holes). If you need perforated sheets, see our perforated sheets line. Say chain link, diamond mesh or diamond jali when you mean this product - unqualified "tar jali" can mean the wrong item.

Hum Noida Sector 9 se Delhi NCR (Delhi, Greater Noida, Gurugram / Gurgaon, Ghaziabad, Faridabad) ke liye 50 ft roll quote karte hain. sections.title: How chain link box size is measured (clear opening)
sections.body:
How chain link box size is measured (clear opening)

  Mesh / box size is the clear inside opening between parallel wires of the diamond, fabric stretched - not center-to-center. GARG quotes 50 / 55 / 75 / 100 mm. Wire is 2.5 / 3 / 4 mm. Heights 3-10 ft. Rolls 50 ft. This matches India trade language and IS 2721-style clear-distance practice.




      Click to enlarge

    Technical reference: measure inside wire-to-wire clear opening - that number is the box / mesh size / aperture.


  Five steps to measure box size on site


    - Stretch a panel so diamonds are regular (not collapsed).

    - Pick one diamond cell.

    - Measure the shortest clear gap between one pair of parallel wires (inside edge to inside edge).

    - Optionally measure the perpendicular pair and average.

    - That millimetre number is the commercial box / mesh size (50, 55, 75 or 100 mm in our range).





[TABLE]




    Spec tip
    If someone measures center-to-center on a true 50 mm opening with 3 mm wire, they may get ~53 mm - but the commercial size is still 50 mm. Always state opening and wire separately. See also spec stacks buyers quote.

sections.body:

      GI chain link is our default for outdoor boundary walls, industrial perimeters, farms and schools across Delhi NCR. Zinc slows rust on the fabric. Also searched as galvanized chain link fencing, galvanised GI mesh, or GI fencing jali.


        - Outdoor / long-life default

        - Buy GI chain link fencing for Noida / Delhi NCR projects

      MS (mild steel) chain link mesh

      MS chain link is the economy option when the fence will be painted or coated after install, or for temporary / cost-sensitive compounds. Without coating, outdoor life is limited.

sections.title: Frequently asked questions
sections.body:
Frequently asked questions

  PAA-style answers for GI / MS chain link, diamond jali and Delhi NCR buyers. Need a quote - call 9910238277.


    How is chain link mesh / box size measured?
    Mesh (box) size is the clear inside opening between parallel wires of the diamond, with the fabric in normal stretched condition - not center-to-center. GARG stocks 50 mm, 55 mm, 75 mm and 100 mm clear openings (about 2 inch, 2.2 inch, 3 inch and 4 inch).




    Is mesh size center-to-center or clear opening?
    Clear opening. Chain link box size is inside wire-to-wire on the diamond, not center-to-center pitch. Center-to-center on a true 50 mm opening with 3 mm wire can read about 53 mm, but the commercial size is still 50 mm.




    What heights of chain link fencing do you supply?
    Heights from 3 ft to 10 ft - all sizes: 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 ft. That is the fabric roll width (fence height), not post height alone. Custom height within this range is quoted on RFQ.




    What wire thicknesses are available?
    Wire diameter 2.5 mm, 3 mm and 4 mm. Use 2.5 mm for economy or temporary work, 3 mm as the commercial default, and 4 mm for heavy-duty industrial, farm or security perimeter. Wire mm is not the same as mesh mm.




    What mesh sizes do you stock?
    Mesh / box clear openings of 50 mm, 55 mm, 75 mm and 100 mm. 50 mm is the most common security and school stack; 75 mm and 100 mm suit economy or farm openings. Always state clear opening on the RFQ.




    What is the standard roll length in India?
    Standard roll length is 50 ft (50 feet / 50ft roll). Confirm running feet or cut length on project RFQs. Pair height with roll length when you quote - for example 6ft x 50ft GI chain link roll.




    GI vs MS chain link - which should I buy?
    Choose GI (galvanized / galvanised) for outdoor and long-life boundary, industrial and farm fencing - zinc slows rust. Choose MS (mild steel) for budget or temporary work when you will paint or coat after install. For wet or long outdoor exposure we usually recommend GI.




    Difference between 50 mm and 75 mm chain link?
    50 mm clear opening is tighter - better deterrence for schools, compounds and industrial perimeters. 75 mm (about 3 inch) is a larger economy opening with less steel per square metre - common on farms and cost-sensitive runs. Wire diameter is still specified separately (2.5 / 3 / 4 mm).




    3 mm vs 4 mm wire for boundary / industrial?
    3 mm is the default commercial wire for compound, school and most boundary jobs. 4 mm is heavy-duty for industrial warehouses, farm pressure and security perimeters. Pair either with 50 or 55 mm box for tighter security; ask us if you are unsure.




    What is diamond jali / heera jali / chain link jali?
    Diamond jali, heera jali, fencing jali and chain link jali are common Hindi/Hinglish names for the same diamond-weave chain link mesh sold in rolls. It is not welded mesh panels or perforated sheet. Quote with height (3-10 ft), wire mm, box mm and GI or MS.




    Do you make PVC coated or green chain link fencing?
    Our core stock is GI and MS chain link fabric. PVC-coated or green chain link is available on request when sourced for the project - ask on the RFQ rather than assuming a fixed colour catalogue. For outdoor life without colour, GI is the default.




    Is your chain link fencing IS 2721 compliant?
    Our dimensions follow common IS 2721 practice for galvanized chain-link fabric (clear opening, wire and height language). We do not stamp ISI certified without an MTC for your order. Ask for coating or test certificates on the RFQ if your tender requires them.




    How do I send an RFQ for chain link rolls?
    Send material (GI/MS), height (3-10 ft), wire (2.5/3/4 mm), mesh/box (50/55/75/100 mm), quantity of 50 ft rolls, destination city, and posts/tension wire/gates Y/N. WhatsApp or call +91 9910238277 - example: 6ft GI chain link, 50mm box, 3mm wire, 50ft rolls, qty?




    Chain link jali vs perforated sheet / welded mesh?
    Chain link (fencing jali / diamond jali) is interlocked diamond wire fabric in rolls. Welded mesh is welded wire panels. Perforated sheet is punched plate with holes. Say chain link or diamond mesh when you mean this product so we do not ship the wrong jali. See perforated sheets if that is what you need.




    Do you supply posts, gates, and tension wire?
    Yes - ask for posts, tension wire / stretcher wire, and gates as accessories with your mesh RFQ. Primary supply is GI / MS chain link fabric; accessories support the fence install rather than replacing the fabric quote.




    What affects chain link fencing price per roll / per kg?
    Price depends on height, wire diameter, mesh/box size, GI vs MS, zinc coating, quantity of 50 ft rolls, and destination freight - not a single list rate in Rs/kg or Rs/sq ft. Marketplace stickers vary because stacks differ. Send the full stack for an accurate factory quote from Noida.




    Do you supply chain link fencing in Delhi NCR / Noida?
    Yes. We manufacture and supply from G 25, Sector 9, Noida 201301 across Delhi NCR - Delhi, Greater Noida, Gurugram / Gurgaon, Ghaziabad and Faridabad - plus India-wide freight and export packing when required. Call +91 9910238277 for lead time. We sell fabric rolls; ask if you need delivery only vs install partners.
